notes: Cost = mean USD per question at the cited list prices (usd_list: every request incl. summariser requests). PREREG_v2 Amendment 2: OpenAI gpt-6-luna, standard tier, so this is the billed amount; cache writes are priced at 1.25x input and cached reads at 0.1x.
H7: paired cluster bootstrap over questions, 2000 replicates, seed 7; B* = highest-F1 baseline point, ties lower cost.
